impressive the spikes on its back grow.

pokemon.name: frosmoth
pokemon.description:
It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields
and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings,
causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.

pokemon.name: stonjourner
pokemon.description:
Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific
time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in
a circle.

pokemon.name: eiscue-ice
pokemon.description:
This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool
with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single
hair into the sea to lure in prey.

pokemon.name: indeedee-male
pokemon.description:
Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions
of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the
source of its strength.

pokemon.name: morpeko-full-belly
pokemon.description:
It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if
they’re precious treasures. No matter how much
it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.

pokemon.name: cufant
pokemon.description:
If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon
will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the
rain, turning a vibrant green color.

pokemon.name: copperajah
pokemon.description:
These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have
incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush
giant rocks into powder.

pokemon.name: dracozolt
pokemon.description:
The powerful muscles in its tail generate its
electricity. Compared to its lower body,
its upper half is entirely too small.

pokemon.name: arctozolt
pokemon.description:
This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and
was able to preserve food with the ice on its
body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.

pokemon.name: dracovish
pokemon.description:
Its mighty legs are capable of running at
speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon
can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.

pokemon.name: arctovish
pokemon.description:
The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but
breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go
extinct anyway.

pokemon.name: duraludon
pokemon.description:
The special metal that composes its body is very
light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility.
It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.

pokemon.name: dreepy
pokemon.description:
If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child
could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help
it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.

pokemon.name: drakloak
pokemon.description:
Without a Dreepy to place on its head and
care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute
any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.

pokemon.name: dragapult
pokemon.description:
Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s
horns eagerly look forward to being launched out
at Mach speeds.

pokemon.name: zacian
pokemon.description:
This Pokémon has slumbered for many years.
Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others
say the two Pokémon are rivals.

pokemon.name: zamazenta
pokemon.description:
This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of
a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot
that it ever existed.

pokemon.name: eternatus
pokemon.description:
It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years
ago. There seems to be a connection between
this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.

pokemon.name: kubfu
pokemon.description:
If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head,
its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up
from the depths of its belly.

pokemon.name: urshifu-single-strike
pokemon.description:
Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this
Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs
and refining its moves.

pokemon.name: zarude
pokemon.description:
Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they
become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants
of the forest grow.

pokemon.name: regieleki
pokemon.description:
Its entire body is made up of a single organ that
generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable
of creating all Galar’s electricity.

pokemon.name: regidrago
pokemon.description:
Its body is composed of crystallized dragon
energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of
every dragon Pokémon.

pokemon.name: glastrier
pokemon.description:
Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and
the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times
harder than diamond.

pokemon.name: spectrier
pokemon.description:
As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs
the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves
silence and solitude.

pokemon.name: calyrex
pokemon.description:
Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled
over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to
cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.

pokemon.name: wyrdeer
pokemon.description:
The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is
erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains
heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

pokemon.name: kleavor
pokemon.description:
A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes
and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon
this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

pokemon.name: ursaluna
pokemon.description:
I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its
burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat
at will.

pokemon.name: basculegion-male
pokemon.description:
Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before
fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species
throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

pokemon.name: sneasler
pokemon.description:
Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical
prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen
highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.

pokemon.name: overqwil
pokemon.description:
Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the
nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

pokemon.name: enamorus-incarnate
pokemon.description:
When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter
comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love
gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

pokemon.name: sprigatito
pokemon.description: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

pokemon.name: floragato
pokemon.description: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

pokemon.name: meowscarada
pokemon.description: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

pokemon.name: fuecoco
pokemon.description: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

pokemon.name: crocalor
pokemon.description: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

pokemon.name: skeledirge
pokemon.description: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

pokemon.name: quaxly
pokemon.description: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

pokemon.name: quaxwell
pokemon.description: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

pokemon.name: quaquaval
pokemon.description: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

pokemon.name: lechonk
pokemon.description: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

pokemon.name: oinkologne-male
pokemon.description: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

pokemon.name: tarountula
pokemon.description: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

pokemon.name: spidops
pokemon.description: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

pokemon.name: nymble
pokemon.description: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

pokemon.name: lokix
pokemon.description: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

pokemon.name: pawmi
pokemon.description: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

pokemon.name: pawmo
pokemon.description: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

pokemon.name: pawmot
pokemon.description: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

pokemon.name: tandemaus
pokemon.description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

pokemon.name: maushold-family-of-four
pokemon.description: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

pokemon.name: fidough
pokemon.description: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

pokemon.name: dachsbun
pokemon.description: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

pokemon.name: smoliv
pokemon.description: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

pokemon.name: dolliv
pokemon.description: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

pokemon.name: arboliva
pokemon.description: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

pokemon.name: squawkabilly-green-plumage
pokemon.description: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

pokemon.name: nacli
pokemon.description: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

pokemon.name: naclstack
pokemon.description: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

pokemon.name: garganacl
pokemon.description: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

pokemon.name: charcadet
pokemon.description: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

pokemon.name: armarouge
pokemon.description: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

pokemon.name: ceruledge
pokemon.description: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

pokemon.name: tadbulb
pokemon.description: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

pokemon.name: bellibolt
pokemon.description: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

pokemon.name: wattrel
pokemon.description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

pokemon.name: kilowattrel
pokemon.description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

pokemon.name: maschiff
pokemon.description: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

pokemon.name: mabosstiff
pokemon.description: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

pokemon.name: shroodle
pokemon.description: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

pokemon.name: grafaiai
pokemon.description: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

pokemon.name: bramblin
pokemon.description: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

pokemon.name: brambleghast
pokemon.description: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

pokemon.name: toedscool
pokemon.description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

pokemon.name: toedscruel
pokemon.description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

pokemon.name: klawf
pokemon.description: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

pokemon.name: capsakid
pokemon.description: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

pokemon.name: scovillain
pokemon.description: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

pokemon.name: rellor
pokemon.description: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

pokemon.name: rabsca
pokemon.description: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

pokemon.name: flittle
pokemon.description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

pokemon.name: espathra
pokemon.description: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

pokemon.name: tinkatink
pokemon.description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

pokemon.name: tinkatuff
pokemon.description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

pokemon.name: tinkaton
pokemon.description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

pokemon.name: wiglett
pokemon.description: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

pokemon.name: wugtrio
pokemon.description: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

pokemon.name: bombirdier
pokemon.description: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

pokemon.name: finizen
pokemon.description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

pokemon.name: palafin-zero
pokemon.description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

pokemon.name: varoom
pokemon.description: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

pokemon.name: revavroom
pokemon.description: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

pokemon.name: cyclizar
pokemon.description: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

pokemon.name: orthworm
pokemon.description: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

pokemon.name: glimmet
pokemon.description: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

pokemon.name: glimmora
pokemon.description: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

pokemon.name: greavard
pokemon.description: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

pokemon.name: houndstone
pokemon.description: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

pokemon.name: flamigo
pokemon.description: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

pokemon.name: cetoddle
pokemon.description: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

pokemon.name: cetitan
pokemon.description: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

pokemon.name: veluza
pokemon.description: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

pokemon.name: dondozo
pokemon.description: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

pokemon.name: tatsugiri-curly
pokemon.description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

pokemon.name: annihilape
pokemon.description: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

pokemon.name: clodsire
pokemon.description: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

pokemon.name: farigiraf
pokemon.description: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

pokemon.name: dudunsparce-two-segment
pokemon.description: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

pokemon.name: kingambit
pokemon.description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

pokemon.name: great-tusk
pokemon.description: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

pokemon.name: scream-tail
pokemon.description: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

pokemon.name: brute-bonnet
pokemon.description: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

pokemon.name: flutter-mane
pokemon.description: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

pokemon.name: slither-wing
pokemon.description: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

pokemon.name: sandy-shocks
pokemon.description: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

pokemon.name: iron-treads
pokemon.description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

pokemon.name: iron-bundle
pokemon.description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

pokemon.name: iron-hands
pokemon.description: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

pokemon.name: iron-jugulis
pokemon.description: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

pokemon.name: iron-moth
pokemon.description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

pokemon.name: iron-thorns
pokemon.description: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

pokemon.name: frigibax
pokemon.description: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

pokemon.name: arctibax
pokemon.description: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

pokemon.name: baxcalibur
pokemon.description: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

pokemon.name: gimmighoul
pokemon.description: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

pokemon.name: gholdengo
pokemon.description: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

pokemon.name: wo-chien
pokemon.description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

pokemon.name: chien-pao
pokemon.description: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

pokemon.name: ting-lu
pokemon.description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

pokemon.name: chi-yu
pokemon.description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

pokemon.name: roaring-moon
pokemon.description: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

pokemon.name: iron-valiant
pokemon.description: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

pokemon.name: koraidon
pokemon.description: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

pokemon.name: miraidon
pokemon.description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

pokemon.name: walking-wake
pokemon.description: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

pokemon.name: iron-leaves
pokemon.description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

pokemon.name: dipplin
pokemon.description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

pokemon.name: poltchageist
pokemon.description: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

pokemon.name: sinistcha
pokemon.description: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

pokemon.name: okidogi
pokemon.description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

pokemon.name: munkidori
pokemon.description: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

pokemon.name: fezandipiti
pokemon.description: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

pokemon.name: ogerpon
pokemon.description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

pokemon.name: archaludon
pokemon.description: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

pokemon.name: hydrapple
pokemon.description: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.

pokemon.name: gouging-fire
pokemon.description: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.

pokemon.name: raging-bolt
pokemon.description: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.

pokemon.name: iron-boulder
pokemon.description: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.

pokemon.name: iron-crown
pokemon.description: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.

pokemon.name: terapagos
pokemon.description: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

pokemon.name: pecharunt
pokemon.description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

pokemon.name: ursaluna-bloodmoon
pokemon.description:
I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its
burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat
at will.
